purpose: Verify that an application satisfying all machine-checkable mandatory criteria of the active cycle policy version is allowed to proceed.
preconditions: A published scholarship scheme is active for the current cycle with defined machine-checkable mandatory eligibility criteria; a student meets all mandatory criteria.
action_or_input: Student initiates and submits a scholarship application for the scheme.
expected_result: The eligibility check passes against the applicable policy version and the application is permitted to proceed to submission.

purpose: Verify that an application failing machine-checkable mandatory criteria is blocked when no reviewable exception path is configured, even if a Convener attempts an undocumented override.
preconditions: A published scholarship scheme is active with machine-checkable mandatory criteria and no configured reviewable exception path; a student does not meet the mandatory criteria.
action_or_input: Student attempts to proceed with an application/submission, and a SPACS Convener attempts an undocumented override.
expected_result: The system blocks progression of the application and rejects any undocumented Convener override.

purpose: Verify that an application failing machine-checkable mandatory criteria is allowed to proceed through a reviewable exception path when explicitly provided by the active scheme policy.
preconditions: A published scholarship scheme explicitly defines a reviewable exception path for a mandatory criterion; a student fails that criterion.
action_or_input: Student initiates and submits an application invoking the configured reviewable exception path.
expected_result: The system allows the application to proceed via the configured reviewable exception path under the active policy version.

purpose: Verify that a student cannot create or submit a duplicate active/submitted application for the same scholarship and academic cycle by default.
preconditions: A published scholarship scheme does not permit duplicates; a student already has an active or submitted application for that scholarship in the current academic cycle.
action_or_input: The same student attempts to create or submit a second application for the same scholarship and academic cycle.
expected_result: The system rejects the duplicate application creation/submission.

purpose: Verify that a student can submit multiple applications for the same scholarship and academic cycle when the active scheme explicitly permits duplicates.
preconditions: A published scholarship scheme explicitly configures an exception permitting duplicate applications; a student already has an active/submitted application for that scheme and cycle.
action_or_input: The same student creates and submits another application for the same scholarship and academic cycle.
expected_result: The system accepts the additional application in accordance with the configured scheme exception.

purpose: Verify that previously uploaded documents belonging to the student, still valid, and matching the required document type/evidence are offered for reuse.
preconditions: A student has an existing uploaded document in their profile that is still valid and matches the document type/evidence required by the selected scheme.
action_or_input: Student selects documents while filling out an application or renewal for the scheme.
expected_result: The system offers the valid, matching prior document for reuse without requiring a new upload.

purpose: Verify that expired documents, mismatched document types, or documents belonging to another student cannot be reused and a new upload is required.
preconditions: A student has an expired document or a document of a non-matching type, and another student has a valid matching document.
action_or_input: Student accesses document selection for an application/renewal and attempts to reuse an expired, wrong-type, or another student's document.
expected_result: The system does not offer or accept invalid, mismatched, or non-owned documents for reuse and requires a new document upload.

purpose: Verify that an application or renewal submission is accepted when all mandatory fields and required documents for the active scheme version are present.
preconditions: A student has populated all mandatory fields and attached all required documents defined by the applicable scheme version.
action_or_input: Student submits or resubmits the application or renewal.
expected_result: The submission/resubmission is accepted, assigned a unique application identifier and timestamp, and transitions to Submitted.

purpose: Verify that an incomplete submission or resubmission missing mandatory fields or required documents is blocked and missing items are identified.
preconditions: A student has omitted at least one mandatory field or required document defined by the applicable scheme version.
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit or resubmit the incomplete application or renewal.
expected_result: The system blocks the submission/resubmission and explicitly identifies the missing mandatory fields and/or required documents.

purpose: Verify that an assigned/authorized SPACS Assistant or SPACS Convener is granted access to review scholarship applications and supporting evidence.
preconditions: A submitted application exists; a user holds an assigned/authorized SPACS Assistant or SPACS Convener role for the application.
action_or_input: The authorized SPACS Assistant or SPACS Convener opens the application review record and supporting evidence.
expected_result: The system grants read/review access to the application and its supporting evidence.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized users or unassigned personnel are denied access to scholarship application review records and supporting evidence.
preconditions: A submitted application exists; a user lacks an assigned/authorized SPACS Assistant or SPACS Convener role for that record.
action_or_input: The unauthorized/unassigned user attempts to open the application review record or supporting evidence.
expected_result: The system denies access to the application review record and supporting evidence.

purpose: Verify that when a SPACS Assistant marks an application as verified or records a verification concern, it is routed to the SPACS Convener rather than finalized.
preconditions: A submitted application is assigned to a SPACS Assistant for verification.
action_or_input: The SPACS Assistant records a verified outcome or a verification concern.
expected_result: The application is routed to the SPACS Convener for decision and is not marked as finally approved or rejected.

purpose: Verify that when a SPACS Assistant requests a correction, the application is routed back to the student and the Assistant is prevented from issuing a final approval/rejection.
preconditions: A submitted application is assigned to a SPACS Assistant for verification.
action_or_input: The SPACS Assistant records a correction request, and also attempts to execute a final scholarship approval or rejection action.
expected_result: The correction request routes the application to the student in a correction-required state, and the system blocks the Assistant from making any final approval or rejection decision.

purpose: Verify that a draft application or renewal is persisted when explicitly saved by the user or when a recoverable timeout/system error occurs, allowing later resumption.
preconditions: A student has started an application or renewal and entered partial form data.
action_or_input: The student triggers an explicit save, and in a subsequent edit triggers a recoverable session timeout or recoverable system error.
expected_result: The draft data is preserved in both scenarios and the student can later reopen and resume editing the saved draft.

purpose: Verify that configured e-mail and in-dashboard notifications (and no SMS notifications) are issued to affected students and/or responsible roles upon significant lifecycle events.
preconditions: Notifications are configured for submission, correction request, verification/decision outcome, withdrawal, renewal reminder, and award announcement.
action_or_input: Trigger a configured significant lifecycle event such as application submission or decision recording.
expected_result: The system generates and dispatches the configured e-mail and in-dashboard notifications to the affected student and/or responsible role, without sending SMS notifications.

purpose: Verify that an owning student can withdraw an application/renewal in a lifecycle-designated withdrawable state before final decision without requiring staff acknowledgement.
preconditions: An application/renewal is in a state designated as withdrawable by the active scheme lifecycle and has no final decision.
action_or_input: The owning student submits a withdrawal request (with required withdrawal reason if configured).
expected_result: The application status immediately changes to Withdrawn without waiting for staff acknowledgement, pending tasks are closed, and the withdrawal action is logged.

purpose: Verify that withdrawal is rejected when an application/renewal is in a non-withdrawable state or after a final decision has been recorded.
preconditions: An application/renewal is in a state not designated as withdrawable or already has a final approved/rejected decision.
action_or_input: The owning student attempts to withdraw the application/renewal.
expected_result: The system rejects the withdrawal request and preserves the current application state.

purpose: Verify that only the owning student can modify or withdraw their application/renewal through the student interface and non-owners are denied.
preconditions: Student A owns a scholarship application/renewal in an editable/withdrawable state; Student B is authenticated on the student interface.
action_or_input: Student B attempts to modify or withdraw Student A's application/renewal via the student interface.
expected_result: The system denies Student B's modification and withdrawal requests and leaves Student A's record unchanged.

purpose: Verify that resubmitting after a correction request or making a substantive modification revalidates the application and invalidates affected prior verification/routing information.
preconditions: An application has prior verification/routing records and is in Correction Required or an editable Submitted state.
action_or_input: The owning student makes a substantive modification or updates and resubmits the application following a correction request.
expected_result: The system performs fresh validation, clears prior verification/routing information affected by the change, and returns the application to the appropriate verification state.

purpose: Verify that a student can download/print only their own application and is denied export access to another student's application.
preconditions: Submitted applications exist for Student A and Student B.
action_or_input: Student A requests download/print export for their own application, and subsequently attempts to export Student B's application.
expected_result: The system allows Student A to download/print their own application and denies export access to Student B's application.

purpose: Verify that authorized SPACS staff can export applications for legitimate processing while unauthorized users are denied export access.
preconditions: A submitted application exists; one user holds an authorized SPACS role for processing and another user holds no authorized SPACS role.
action_or_input: Both users attempt to download/print the application.
expected_result: The system grants export access to the authorized SPACS role and denies export access to the unauthorized user.

purpose: Verify that pending verification or decision tasks do not trigger SLA reminders/escalations before reaching the configured age threshold, and trigger the configured notification upon reaching the threshold without transferring decision authority.
preconditions: A verification or decision task is pending with a configured SLA age threshold and configured notification recipient(s).
action_or_input: Evaluate the pending task just before its age reaches the configured threshold, and then when its age reaches the configured threshold.
expected_result: No SLA notification is issued before the threshold; upon reaching the threshold, the configured reminder/escalation notification is sent to the configured recipient(s) while decision authority remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that applications, renewals, and award cycles bind to the published/active catalogue-policy version covering the cycle and historical records retain the version used even after a new version is published.
preconditions: Catalogue-policy version V1 is published and active for Cycle 1; an application/award record is created under V1; subsequently version V2 is published for Cycle 2.
action_or_input: Inspect the historical Cycle 1 record after V2 becomes active, and create a new record for Cycle 2.
expected_result: The Cycle 2 record uses active version V2, while the historical Cycle 1 record continues to reference and retain version V1.

purpose: Verify that publishing/activating a policy-affecting catalogue version is blocked without required policy approval metadata and succeeds when valid approval reference/evidence is provided.
preconditions: A SPACS Convener has drafted a policy-affecting catalogue entry/version.
action_or_input: The SPACS Convener attempts to publish/activate the version without policy approval reference/evidence, and then retries with required policy approval metadata.
expected_result: The system blocks publication when approval metadata is missing and allows publication/activation once the required policy approval reference/evidence is supplied.

purpose: Verify that uploading a valid-format document passes machine-checkable metadata validation but is not marked as authenticated until verified by an authorized human reviewer or explicit external verification service.
preconditions: An application includes an uploaded supporting document satisfying file presence, type, and date checks; no external verification service has confirmed authenticity.
action_or_input: Student submits the application, and an authorized reviewer subsequently records substantive verification.
expected_result: On upload/submission, the document is not marked authenticated/substantively verified; authenticity is recorded only after the authorized reviewer (or configured external verification service) records verification.

purpose: Verify that a scholarship renewal enforces scheme-specific renewal rules (eligibility, duration, refreshed evidence, timing) and routes through fresh verification and decision rather than auto-approving unless explicitly configured.
preconditions: A renewable scholarship scheme is active with configured renewal window, duration limit, required refreshed evidence, and no auto-approval policy; a prior recipient applies within the valid window and duration.
action_or_input: The student submits a renewal application with required refreshed evidence.
expected_result: The renewal is validated against active scheme renewal rules, is not automatically approved, and is routed through fresh verification and sanction decision.

purpose: Verify that a renewal attempt outside the scheme's configured renewal window or beyond its configured eligible duration is rejected.
preconditions: A renewable scholarship scheme defines a specific renewal window and maximum eligible duration; a student attempts renewal outside the window or past the allowed duration.
action_or_input: The student attempts to initiate or submit a renewal application.
expected_result: The system blocks the renewal application as non-compliant with the configured renewal policy timing/duration.

purpose: Verify that final scholarship approval or rejection is accepted from the SPACS Convener or explicitly scheme-configured decision authority, and rejected from unauthorized roles including SPACS Assistant.
preconditions: A verified scholarship application awaits final decision under a scheme where the SPACS Convener (or explicitly configured authority) is the decision maker.
action_or_input: A SPACS Assistant attempts to submit a final approval/rejection decision, followed by the authorized SPACS Convener (or configured authority) submitting the final decision.
expected_result: The system denies the SPACS Assistant's decision attempt and records the final approval/rejection when submitted by the authorized decision role.

purpose: Verify that convocation award evaluation, recommendation, and final approval route to and accept decisions only from the committee/authority configured in the active award policy rather than defaulting to the SPACS Convener.
preconditions: Two convocation award schemes are configured with distinct evaluation committees and approving authorities (distinct from the SPACS Convener); candidate pools are prepared.
action_or_input: Route award evaluation and final approval tasks, and attempt final approval as the SPACS Convener versus the policy-configured approving authority.
expected_result: Tasks route to each award's configured committee/authority; the SPACS Convener is blocked from acting as sole deciding authority where not configured, and decisions from the policy-configured committee/authority are accepted.

purpose: Verify that award candidate generation and evaluation use the award criteria version effective for that award cycle and preserve the criteria/version used on the award record.
preconditions: An award scheme has criteria version C1 effective for the current award cycle; a newer criteria version C2 is configured for a future cycle.
action_or_input: Generate candidates and record committee evaluation for the current award cycle.
expected_result: Candidate generation and evaluation apply criteria version C1, and the award cycle records permanently retain the reference to criteria version C1.

purpose: Verify that significant SPACS actions generate timestamped audit log entries that cannot be modified by ordinary users and are viewable only by authorized personnel.
preconditions: A significant SPACS action (such as submission, decision, withdrawal, or catalogue publication) is completed; an ordinary user (Student) and authorized audit personnel exist.
action_or_input: Inspect audit logs as authorized personnel, attempt to view audit logs as an ordinary user, and attempt to modify an existing audit log record.
expected_result: A timestamped audit record exists for the action; authorized personnel can view it, ordinary users are denied read access, and all attempts to modify audit records are blocked.

purpose: Verify that reassigning a SPACS role routes pending role-based tasks to the new role holder while preserving the historical actor identity on previously completed actions.
preconditions: User A holds a SPACS role, has completed an action on Application 1, and has a pending task on Application 2; role assignment is transferred from User A to User B.
action_or_input: Execute the role reassignment from User A to User B and inspect both the pending task queue and completed action history.
expected_result: The pending task on Application 2 is routed to User B, while the completed action and audit history on Application 1 retain User A as the historical actor.

purpose: Verify that opening an award cycle obtains candidates using the scheme's configured candidate-source method (e.g., system-generated eligible pool, nomination, or application) without assuming student application is required.
preconditions: Award Scheme A is configured for system-generated eligible pool from academic records (without student application), and Award Scheme B is configured for nomination.
action_or_input: Open award cycles for Award Scheme A and Award Scheme B.
expected_result: Award Scheme A generates candidates from academic records without requiring student applications, and Award Scheme B initializes candidate intake via nomination in accordance with each scheme's active policy.
